Garage Sauna

A two-person garage sauna fits in about 4 by 6 feet with a 7 foot ceiling. Most traditional heaters need a dedicated 240V circuit, and the room needs real insulation and a vapor barrier, because concrete and uninsulated garage walls pull heat away fast. A plug-in infrared unit is the simplest option.

Swipe for the details. The full guide, with every source linked, is at the link in bio.
